title: RecordTransactionPayload
description: Payload schema for the RECORD_TRANSACTION intent. Posts a completed financial event to the books. Recording is unilateral when documentation and (for spends above threshold) approval chain are present.

transaction_id.description: Globally unique transaction identifier. Duplicates are rejected (replay protection).

amount.description: Absolute transaction amount, always positive. Use 'direction' to indicate inflow vs outflow.

category.description: Tax category. 'personal' is rare and flags for review.

direction.description: Whether money is entering (inflow) or leaving (outflow) the business.

vendor_or_customer.description: Counterparty name. Required for any non-internal transaction.

receipt_attached.description: Must be true. Recording without supporting documentation is refused.

receipt_ref.description: Stored receipt or invoice reference (e.g. 'receipt-2026-04-26-001'). Required if receipt_attached is true.

business_id.description: Business unit / cost center the transaction posts against. Must exist in the business registry.

occurred_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the transaction actually occurred (not when recorded).

recorded_at.description: UTC timestamp of when this record was posted to the books.

approved_by.description: Approval chain that authorized the underlying spend. Required for outflows above policy threshold; not required for inflows or sub-threshold spends.

business_purpose.description: Business purpose statement (required by Tax Agent for deductibility). May be brief but must exist.

ledger_ref.description: Reference to the immutable ledger entry this transaction is anchored to.

linked_request_id.description: Optional reference to the upstream purchase or invoice request this transaction satisfies.

allOf.description: Outflows above the auto-approval threshold ($500) require an approved_by chain.
If receipt_attached is true, receipt_ref must be provided.
